window_rim.timing: the frame of every window on a 17x17 UI px window at one art px per UI px (crisp edges at any UI scale, like the solid rectangles it replaces); the game slices it 9 ways (corners 8 UI px) over the lacquer body

window_glow.timing: eight bands of the window's top-lit wash, one per row; the game stretches each over the body's width and 1/16 of its height

sort_mark.timing: a small triangle, up then down, white and tinted; marks a list's sort and the HUD's fold; an 8 px clear margin keeps the smooth downscale from picking up the neighbouring frames

scroll_mark.timing: a scroll button's triangle, up then down, white and tinted; an 8 px clear margin keeps the smooth downscale from picking up the neighbouring frames

icon.timing: the command menu's icons (attack, skill, item, wait) on a 12 UI px square, white and tinted; an 8 px clear margin keeps the smooth downscale from picking up the neighbouring frames

bar_frame.timing: the unit bar's case at game pixels (drawn on the field, not at UI scale); the anchor is the bar's top left inside the edge

bar_fill.timing: the HP fill, enemy then ally: a lit top row, a middle row between, and the darker bottom; the game shows as much of its width as the unit has HP

bar_trail.timing: the white trail behind the HP fill after a hit or ahead of it on a heal

bar_ticks.timing: the quarter ticks over the HP fill

scroll_curl.timing: the dialogue paper's shading toward its left roller at the scroll's art scale; the game stretches it down the paper and mirrors it for the right

scroll_grain.timing: a mark of wood grain on a scroll roller
